description: The pinned catalogue of embedding and rerank models (Phase 89 plan 89-08, RET-05). It is the VALIDATOR for `config-set retrieval.*`: a model that is not listed here cannot be configured. Voyage publishes no model-list endpoint and no usage endpoint, so this file is the authority and a human updates it; see docs/EMBEDDING-MODELS.md for the procedure.

token_estimate.note: The pre-spend count is ceil(characters / 3) per text. Code tokenises at roughly 3 to 4 characters per token, so this over-counts on purpose: a budget gate that under-counts is the dangerous direction. The spend that is RECORDED is the provider's own usage figure whenever the provider reports one.

models.max_tokens_per_request_note: Not listed on the vendor's rate-limit page (read 2026-11-12) and not measured: a per-request cap cannot be measured without sending a request of that size. 120000 is the smallest cap the vendor lists for any model of this family, assumed until measured.
